description:
False block. tests_policy.is_test_path checks every part of the absolute path, so /Users/me/tests/proj/src/app.py counts as a test file and every write in that project blocks.

Fix: check parts relative to the session cwd or project root when the path is inside it; keep the absolute check for paths outside.

Acceptance: a source file in a project under a folder named tests passes; tests/x.py inside the project blocks. Tests by adw-test-writer.
title: Judge test directories relative to the project root
